title: Ginger Sesame Granola
changes_from_base: Tahini and olive oil replace the neutral oil and honey, with ground ginger, cardamom, almonds and sesame; optional egg white helps it clump, and crystallised ginger is stirred in before it cools in the switched-off oven.
summary: A ginger-infused granola with toasted sesame and almond, spiked with flaky sea salt and sticky pieces of crystallised ginger for added depth and chew.
equipment: large rimmed baking tray (about 33 x 46 cm)

steps.title: Heat
steps.text: Preheat the oven to 165 °C (145 °C fan) and line a large rimmed baking tray with baking paper.

steps.title: Syrup
steps.text: In a large bowl, whisk 80 ml maple syrup, 55 g dark brown sugar, 65 g tahini (well stirred), 60 ml olive oil, 2 egg whites if using and 3 tsp vanilla until completely smooth.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Add 480 g rolled oats, 150 g flaked almonds, 50 g sesame seeds, 2 tsp flaky sea salt, 2 tsp ground ginger and ¼ tsp ground cardamom and mix until thoroughly coated.

steps.title: Spread
steps.text: Tip onto the lined tray and spread out.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake for 20 min, then stir and continue baking for about 30 min more, stirring every 10 min, until golden.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Scatter 85 g crystallised ginger chopped over the granola, then switch off the oven and leave the tray inside for 2 h to crisp.

steps.title: Store
steps.text: Keep in an airtight container for up to 3 weeks.

tips: Add the egg whites if you prefer chunkier clusters; omit them for a crunchier texture
Toast the granola in two phases (20 minutes, then 30 minutes) to develop full flavour
Leave it in the turned-off oven with crystallised ginger to finish drying and crisping
storage: Keep in an airtight container for up to 3 weeks. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
